about.title: The story of Sinai Tower INN.
paragraphs: Sinai Tower INN is a family-run hostel in Ecuador, run by its owners. We offer private and shared rooms, free WiFi, a fully equipped kitchen, pool and BBQ. We're in the city center, close to everything you need.

location.description: Ecuador. The ideal location for your trip.

pricing.title: Message us for updated prices based on your dates.

faq.question: Is there parking?
faq.answer: Yes, we have free parking on the property.

faq.question: Can I pay by card?
faq.answer: Ask us, we have several payment options to make it easy for you.

faq.question: What time can I check in and out?
faq.answer: We're flexible with times. Drop us a message and we'll work it out.

faq.question: Is there air conditioning?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll stay cool in summer no problem.

faq.question: Is it close to downtown?
faq.answer: Message us and we'll confirm the exact distance and how to get here from the bus station or airport.
